Confidential data: do not copy it anywhere, do not send it to any external service, do not write any files. Read-only task.

The file /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-akshatkhair-Documents-Projects-ask-soony/fae0b594-812a-4c64-b8d2-5c8d27da09c1/scratchpad/scan_list.txt lists 52 scanned delivery notes (jpg/png, absolute paths before the "|") and what the ERP goods receipt booked for each (PO, material, ordered qty, booked qty, GR date, remark).

Open EVERY image with the Read tool (it displays images). For each, compare the scan with the booking and report ONLY deviations, such as: quantity on the paper differs from booked qty (watch for handwritten corrections, crossed-out numbers, European thousands separators like "5.640" meaning 5,640), different part number or PO, missing or different line items, a handwritten remark/note (translate Polish/Chinese/Korean), "RECEIVED" stamp date differing from GR date or missing, no signature, damage notes, artwork/revision mentions, anything unusual. Supplier part numbers PR-CC-0312 = CMP-GAM-003, PR-SL-0604 = CMP-GAM-004, PR-RB-2207 = CMP-GAM-007 (not a deviation).

Return a compact list: filename -> deviation(s). Then one line stating how many scans matched with no deviation. Be precise; do not guess. Gross weights that look implausibly low are known; mention them only if wildly inconsistent with other notes of the same part.
